name: plan-gap-year
description:
Guides the user through planning a gap year or extended career break,
chaining career strategy, budgeting, savings, learning design, itinerary
building, and safety preparation skills across four categories.
Use when the user wants to take a gap year, plan an extended travel break,
or structure a career sabbatical with intentional learning and travel goals.
Do NOT use for short vacations (under 1 month), retirement planning, or
employer-sponsored sabbaticals with fixed structure.
